The agent-plugin-parity spec's transcript-capture section (dimension K) now describes the common transcript as the ATIF stream it is: a pinned `ATIF-v1.7` header record, one `step` record per turn (ATIF `source`, full-fidelity `message`/`reasoning_content`/`tool_calls` arguments), one `observation` record per streamed tool result (`source_call_id` required, `is_error`/`tool_name` under the result's `extra`), all validated against the canonical record schema at emit time. It links the ATIF alignment spec, which is now marked implemented and whose compatibility note describes the shipped old-format detection (any retired record type, plus a header-first requirement in the doc-builder).

The claude plugin's `test_ratchets.py` silent-decode entry now covers every catch in the package (including `stream_snapshot.py`'s truncated-tail skip) rather than excluding the standalone resource scripts.
